blink.label: Blink the dot
blink.description: Pulse the red dot once per second so it reads as live.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when not recording
hide_when_idle.description: Show nothing at all on the bar while no recording is running.

show_elapsed.label: Show elapsed time
show_elapsed.description: Print the recording duration next to the REC dot.

stop_on_click.label: Click stops the recording
stop_on_click.description: Left-click runs record-screen.sh, which stops the current recording.
